appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015'. This is a strong textual cue that contradicts the visual data.
A single solid blue line is plotted across the graph. The line starts at the bottom-left and extends to the top-right, indicating a positive slope.
The line begins at the year 2010 mark on the x-axis, aligning horizontally with the 2,000 tick mark on the y-axis.
The line ends at the year 2015 mark on the x-axis, aligning horizontally with the 3,000 tick mark on the y-axis.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Population' and features tick marks at intervals of 500, ranging from 0 to 3,500.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and features tick marks for each year from 2010 to 2015.
Despite the title claiming a 'Shrinking Population', the graphical representation clearly shows a steady, linear increase in population over the 5-year period.
